rules.name: The Three-Tone Commitment Rule
rules.body: No arbitrary fourth colors, decorative gradients, or uncalibrated grayscale neutrals.

dos: Do maintain the strict three-color discipline (#B75A48, #E8ECD6, #000000).
Do use geometric shapes (squares, circles, rectangles) as structural components.
donts: Don't introduce generic AI gradients (e.g. purple-to-blue).
Don't wrap everything in a single centered card.
